items.title: Albert Jiles Interview, 1961-02-24
items.q: Guy Yeh, you know talk of him. Used to play a jitney man for him.

ctx.x: What about in the rhythm? Who would he have?
Peter Pappy, and he had some time, and Guy Yeh, you know talk of him. Used to play a jitney man for him. He got killed. Walter.
You played drums with him sometimes?
